model_evidence.locator: Author uncorrected proof dated 30 August 2008: PDF p. 8, Section 5, printed lines 381-383 and Fig. 1 (parameters); PDF p. 2, Section 2, printed line 101 (isotropic linear elastic phases).
model_evidence.scope_note: Only the epoxy/glass particulate-matrix submodel is used, not the paper's full three-phase fiber-reinforced or graded laminate. Glass fraction 0.20 and epoxy fraction 0.80 are an illustration within the plotted range, not a reported specimen. Effective isotropy, perfect bonding, static loading, small strain and 3D homogenized interpretation are calculator assumptions, not independently observed material facts. Temperature, grade, cure and measurement uncertainty are unspecified.
